resources.string: Control TV media volume over your local network.

Keep your controller on the same Wi-Fi/LAN. Commands change Android media volume without requesting a volume overlay. Fixed-volume and HDMI-CEC devices may need TV-specific controls. The receiver uses a quiet ongoing notification.
New token saved. Update your controller.
This TV does not expose battery settings.
This device reports fixed volume. Android volume commands cannot change this output.
No LAN IPv4 address. Connect the TV to Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
Send POST /volume/up or POST /volume/down with Authorization: Bearer <token>. GET /volume/integer reads the volume as a plain number; GET /status returns full JSON status.
